D1_live_usable_timestamp.rule: knowledge_available_at_utc = verification_completed_at_utc of the first double-read observation that is complete by the live rule
D1_live_usable_timestamp.rationale: First-complete had zero contradictions on evidenced sessions; settled double-read alone had four later revisions.

D2_no_verified_complete_fallback.rule: first observation may exist only as PROVISIONAL; it never receives finality authority
D2_no_verified_complete_fallback.all_dash_rule: PENDING_ALL_DASH; never interpret Total 0.0 as observed zero flow

D3_unknown_handling.rule: sessions without timed capture remain LOWER_BOUND_ONLY and are not canonical knowledge-time observations

D4_source_vintage.rule: append-only vintages; replay at cutoff t binds latest vintage observed <= t; later revisions append and never silently rewrite prior scored vintages

D5_historical_backtest_eligibility.rule: ETF features are ineligible for official knowledge-time-sensitive backtests before the first timed capture at 2026-07-15T20:48:00Z
D5_historical_backtest_eligibility.sensitivity_only: Assumed lag scenarios may be run only as explicitly labelled noncanonical SOURCE_VINTAGE_RISK research. 30.6h is evidence, not canonical policy.
D5_historical_backtest_eligibility.rejected_reason: Session close is falsified by proven future-knowledge leakage.

D6_feature_knowledge_time.rule: feature knowledge time = max knowledge_available_at_utc across every input row in the feature window

D7_post_cutoff_revisions.rule: replay at cutoff t cannot see revisions observed after t; re-evaluation on a later vintage is a new labelled run
